inlines.text: 이 페이지는 국가·정부·기관·직위 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.
소비자 계약(authority-and-counting-no-roll): Unique valid ballots and eligible voters; registered tie resolver or vacant, never d10 tie-break or highest-rating appointment.

blocks.text:
D09-CANDIDATE-FILTER [approved-structure-payload-values-per-state] eligible = candidates where eligible=true and, when exam.required, examScore is known in exam.scoreUnit and examScore >= exam.minimumScore
D09-QUORUM [approved-structure-payload-values-per-state] participatingVoters = count(unique valid voter IDs with one valid ballot); met = mode=count ? participatingVoters >= requiredCount : participatingVoters == eligibleVoterCount
D09-VOTE-TALLY [approved-structure] tally[candidateId] = count(valid ballots for candidateId); leaders = eligible candidates with maximal tally
D09-TIE [approved-structure-payload-values-per-state] resolver-order selects the first tied candidate in orderedCandidateIds; remain-vacant selects nobody
D09-LEGITIMACY-STATUS [approved-categorical-only] lawful when approved matching procedure completes selection and every required appointment/ratification condition; otherwise selection-pending|no-candidate|quorum-unmet|tie-unresolved|appointment-blocked
D09-LEGITIMACY-SCORE [proposal-held] null
GURPS-LIKE-REFERENCE [not-used-by-D09-resolution] No 3d6 roll, margin or contest is invoked unless a future per-state payload explicitly and separately approves one.
D09-F1 [후보·승인 전] eligible=explicitEligible && (!examRequired || knownScore>=registeredMinimum); quorum=count(uniqueValidVoters)>=requiredCount OR all mode equality; tally=count(validBallots per candidate)
D09-F2 [후보·승인 전] unique top tally wins selection; tie uses registered resolver order or remains vacant; lawful only after required appointment and ratification

inlines.text: D09의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

items.text: eventId — stableId (identity)
stateId — stableId (identity)
institutionId,officeId — stableId (identity)
holderId — stable person ID|null (identity)
treasury — integer (explicit treasuryUnit)
selector — vote|appointment|exam-then-vote|exam-then-appointment (enum)
candidates — array of {personId,eligible,examScore|null} (person/score-unit)
voters,votes — stable-ID arrays (person/ballot)
quorum — {mode:count,requiredCount}|{mode:all-eligible} (voter-count)
tieRule — {mode:resolver-order,orderedCandidateIds}|{mode:remain-vacant} (identity-order)
examRule — {required,minimumScore,scoreUnit} (declared scoreUnit)
appointmentRule — {appointingActorId,ratifierId|null,ratificationRequired} (identity)
actingRule — {actorId,allowedActions[]}|null (identity/action-id)
snapshotRevision,procedureRevision,rulesVersion — revision (version)

inlines.text: 자료 소유자는 D09 owns country, government, institution, office-procedure, acting-scope, legitimacy-status and continuity records; D01 owns person identity/life; D08 owns family and marriage; D10 owns titles/claims; D11 owns grants and physical handover; D12 owns body succession; D17 owns negotiated terms; D18 owns time/save boundaries, 유지 계약은 D09-CANDIDATE-FILTER·D09-QUORUM·D09-VOTE-TALLY·D09-TIE·D09-LEGITIMACY-STATUS·GURPS-LIKE-REFERENCE다. 상태 소유 경계는 institution+office IDs,procedure revision,eligible candidates/voters,ballots,quorum,tie rule,appointment/ratification,acting scope. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_UNIT, E_EVENT_CONFLICT
기존 평가기 오류: E_INPUT, E_UNIT, E_STALE, E_DUPLICATE, E_PROPOSAL, E_ELIGIBILITY, E_QUORUM, E_TIE, E_AUTHORITY

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

inlines.text: 제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.
이 도메인에는 아직 기록된 신규 모듈 적용 항목이 없다.

현재 범위 한계: No domain-specific new original-trpg module. Reuse existing original bounded contracts; do not mark everything undecided. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D09-office-procedure-resolution(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/office-procedure-resolution.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/office-procedure-resolution.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.

items.text: 직위·절차·대행 요청 — state/institution/office​/event ID, 현재·절차 개정·규칙과 승인 payload. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0])
같은 국가·직위·판본 — 혼합·stale·중복 사건·없는 기관·잘못된 직위 참조 거부. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0])
직위 사건 종류 — 상실·선출 시도·대행·복원을 독립 처리한다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])
대상 직위만 공석 — holder=null,effective=fa​lse,vacant=true. 기관·국고·부채·계보·다른 직위 유지. selection-pending이며 후임 생성 없음. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[1])
승인된 국가·직위 절차 — approvalStatus=approved와​ selector별 필수 fields 필요. 실제 16국 값·기관 payload는 자동 작성하지 않는다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
고유 명시 적격 후보 — eligible=true 후보만 남긴다. ID 중복 거부. 시험 없으면 시험 값을 만들지 않는다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
시험 점수·단위·기준 — 시험 selector는 required=true,등록 scoreUnit·minimumScore와 알려진 후보 점수 필요. score≥minimum만 통과. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
후보 집합 공백 — 자격·시험 후 후보 수 확인. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[4])
후보 없음·공석 유지 — no-candidate. 최고 기량·새 후보·자동 군주 생성 없음. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[3])
투표·임명 경로 — vote/exam-then-vote와 appointment/exam-then-ap​pointment 분리. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[6])
고유 유권자·유효 한 표 — 유일 적격 유권자와 그들의 한 유효 후보 표만 허용. 중복·부적격 표를 합산하지 않는다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4])
등록 정족수 — count: 참여자≥requiredCount; all-eligible:참여자=적격 선거인 수. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
정족수 미달 공석 — quorum-unmet로 공석을 유지한다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[4])
후보별 득표·최대 집합 — 각 적격 후보의 유효 표 수를 세고 최대 득표 후보 집합을 얻는다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
등록 동률 규칙 — resolver-order는 실제 동률/임명 후보 집합의 첫 등록 ID만 선택. remain-vacant는 선택 없음. 미등록 규칙은 보류. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
동률 미결 공석 — tie-unresolved. d10 재굴림·최고 rating 자동 임명 없음. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
선택된 후보 하나 — 후보 선택은 아직 임명·정통성 확정이 아니다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5])
임명자·필수 인준자 — 임명 selector는 등록 임명권자 일치. 모든 selector에서 ratificationRequired=tru​e일 때만 등록 인준자 필요. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[7])
직위·범주 적법성 후보 — holder/effective/vacant와​ categorical lawful 동시 준비. 수치 정통성 발급 없음. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[7])
정확 대행자·행위 범위 — actingRule의 actor와 allowedActions에 정확 일치해야 한다. null은 대행 없음이지 무제한 권한이 아니다. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])
대행 영수증만 — 직위 충원·국고 소유·정통성 수치 없음. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])

대상 결과·영수증 반영 — 공석·분쟁도 영수증 반영 가능. 국고·기관·다른 직위 보존,부분 holder 쓰기 금지. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[1]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[7]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[9])

절차·점수·수치 정책 미결 — E_PROPOSAL. 실제 절차·기준·행위자·인준자·대행·수치 정통성 미정은 이전 상태 유지. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[8])

판본·표·권한 충돌 — 중복·잘못된 참조·부적격 표·단위·동률 resolver 실패·잘못된 임명자·인준자·대행 범위는 원자 거부. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[0]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[2]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[3]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[4]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[5]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[6]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[8]; d09.b9.orderedSteps[9])
취소·사망·복원 — 사망은 영향 받은 시도만 무효화. 완료 선출·대행 재실행 금지. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[9])
공석·기관·이력 유지 — 취소는 선두 후보 임명 아님.후보/유권자/임명자/인준자 사망은 새 snapshot 필요.호환 저장만 복원. (원문: d09.b9.orderedSteps[9])

"For office loss or holder death supplied by the owning lifecycle event, clear only the target office; preserve institution, treasury and unrelated offices; emit selection-pending; generate no replacement."
"For a procedure attempt, require approvalStatus=approved and every field required by that state/office selector. Proposal or missing payload returns E_PROPOSAL with the full before state unchanged."

"Filter candidate records by explicit eligible=true. If the selector requires an examination, require declared score unit and retain candidates whose score is at least the registered threshold. No candidate leaves a vacancy with no-candidate status."
"For vote selectors, validate unique eligible voters and unique ballots, then test the registered quorum exactly. Unmet quorum leaves the vacancy and records quorum-unmet."

"Count one valid ballot per eligible voter. Select the unique highest tally. On a top tie, apply only the registered tie rule: exact resolver order selects the first tied ID present; remain-vacant records tie-unresolved."

"For appointment selectors, require the registered appointing actor. For every selector, require the registered ratifier only when ratificationRequired=tru​e. A missing or wrong actor leaves the office unchanged and fails explicitly."
"Commit holder/effective/vacant and categorical legitimacy together. Preserve treasury and institution fields byte-for-byte; record no numeric legitimacy value."
"For an acting request, require an exact actor and action listed in actingRule. Set only the scoped acting receipt; never fill the office or grant unlisted actions."
"On load, restore receipts and revisions without rerunning selection. On cancel/death during an uncommitted attempt, keep the vacancy and discard no prior institution or treasury history."
"eligible = candidates where eligible=true and, when exam.required, examScore is known in exam.scoreUnit and examScore >= exam.minimumScore"
"participatingVoters = count(unique valid voter IDs with one valid ballot); met = mode=count ? participatingVoters >= requiredCount : participatingVoters == eligibleVoterCount"
"tally[candidateId] = count(valid ballots for candidateId); leaders = eligible candidates with maximal tally"
"resolver-order selects the first tied candidate in orderedCandidateIds; remain-vacant selects nobody"

"lawful when approved matching procedure completes selection and every required appointment/ratification​ condition; otherwise selection-pending|n​o-candidate|quorum-​unmet|tie-unresolve​d|appointment-block​ed"

"Public GURPS-like arithmetic is not an election or legitimacy rule."

"None in the approved D09 structure. Random tie breakers, generated candidates and hidden legitimacy rolls are prohibited unless a later state-specific approved payload defines stream, draw count and receipt."
"Event-driven under D18 checkpoint time. No daily/monthly turn, deadline, campaign pause, speed control or auto-election cadence is invented."
"Counts and scores use exact integers in their declared units. No percentage conversion, rounding or legitimacy clamp is approved."
